description: Answers one entry of the feedback on a spec the signed-in person published, closes it, or opens it again. answer is plain text of up to 1,000 characters, shown under the entry with the publisher's username; a new answer takes the place of the one before. close true closes the entry. closedIn names the published version that settled it, and closes it too. close false opens it again. Give at least one of answer, close or closedIn. Only the spec's publisher can answer, and nobody can change what an entry says. The answer is public, so ask the person before you call it. This tool needs sign-in.

answer.description: What the publisher says back, in plain text.

close.description: True to close the entry, false to open it again.

closedIn.description: The published version that settled it, like 1.4.1. Giving it closes the entry.

entry.description: The entry's number, as get_feedback gives it.

name: answer_feedback
title: Answer feedback on your spec
